`public.p12` was produced by `github.com/krotos139/go-gostcrypto` at commit
`409be1d9982195558ce16fabd5d0ad20454bee3c` using `pfx.MarshalWithKey`.
The recipient and sender use the published R 1323565.1.041-2022 Appendix A.4
test key and certificate already stored in `../r1323565_1_041_2022_a4_recipient.b64`.
The certificates were placed in an unencrypted section. The private-key section
uses GOST 28147-89/CryptoPro-A CMS key transport with a GOST 2012/256 recipient.
The key is public test material and must not be used for real credentials.
